top_signals.title: Fed Gov Lisa Cook’s lawyer fires back at Trump's renewed threat to oust her
top_signals.summary: The Supreme Court in late June blocked Trump from firing Cook from the Federal Reserve, but left the president with a path to try again to remove her.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
